recipe: frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14 with 4 register tokens, temporally self-supervised on the pre-cleavage window; 3-seed 256x2 distributional head, no TTA
outputIs: log(mean posterior) -- softmax recovers the posterior exactly
unit: hours until first cleavage; from the corpus' own per-frame clock, no assumed interval
valProtocol: 6-fold grouped CV over 536 patient-slide components, 3 seeds
heldOutNote: NO held-out estimate exists. The sealed vault was deliberately folded into training on 2026-08-24, so every figure here is cross-validation. The last clean measurement on embryos the trunk had never seen was 2.887 h, and it cannot be repeated.
partsNote: Stored as 3 consecutive byte-range parts because wrangler refuses objects over 300 MiB and the graph is 581 MiB. Concatenating part0..part2 in order reproduces the file byte for byte; `sha256` is the checksum of the reassembled whole.
